newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures cut large gains late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures cut large gains late.

text.p: April 28 - U.S. stock index futures cut gains late. A strong close in T-bond futures lent support. But some brokers had noted surprise that stocks rose as far as they did and wondered whether the rise would give way to profittaking before this week's spate of US economic data. Intraday support stands near 773.95, more near 772.50-773.00 in June S&Ps. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
